_comment: Provider template — FILENAME=ROUTE (deepseek: the credential+endpoint channel; token var derives from it). `_family` = MODEL LINEAGE (deepseek) — the same/different-family judgment unit (model-routing.md). `model` = the pinned per-generation id, never part of the filename. Route: the official DeepSeek API (api.deepseek.com) — one route of the deepseek family. EXAMPLE of a user-authored provider extension: copy this file to profiles/<name>.json, set routing + <UPPERCASE-NAME>_ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (convention; override via `_token_env`); no code change. See install.md. ADR #40. Sanitized copy of parallel-development's profiles/deepseek.json (CSR-I3 substrate — rule 7 copy-pattern). ADR #53 annotation (2026-09-12): pinned id aligned to the OFFICIAL stable alias deepseek-flash[1m] (api-docs.deepseek.com quick_start/agent_integrations/claude_code snippet; generation-suffixed names drift — the docs' own snapshot moved v4-pro[1m]->flash between revisions). EFFORT_LEVEL set high 2026-09-15 (was max per the official snippet; max measured inert via env-only path — see below — and both 2026-09-15 substrate stalls ran under it; high is the thinking-mode default) but MEASURED INERT through the env-only wrapper path (2026-09-12 A/B: unset 19.5/19.5KB vs max 18.0KB thinking, overlapping; CC 2.1.251 flags the id unrecognized) — zero cost, zero effect today, becomes live if CC's matcher adopts the alias; thinking-mode docs (guides/thinking_mode) put the default at effort=high with max the only higher level, parameter-controlled on a single model line — SUPERSEDES ADR #53's 'model VARIANT is the only working dial' claim. Flash finding-yield validated live 2026-09-12 (a waf-project session, R17: flash hetero leg outperformed and broke a stuck loop; user-reported). See ADR #68.
